title: 211 mV Four-Quadrant Tunnel Modulator Deterministic Benchmark Contract
owner: David Lee Wise / ROOT0 / TriPod LLC

normative.bias_classification: candidate operating bias; not a universal tunnelling threshold
normative.mirror_inverse_rule: reverse the left symbol order, then invert every symbol
normative.remembered_word_classification: two opposing quadrants plus terminal pilot; not a four-quadrant cycle

transport_protocol.operation: establish the trap or receiving boundary
deposit the encapsulated payload and return

normative.spinor_classification: conditional payload type only; the four-trip protocol is not itself a spinor
spinor_requirements: payload is a normalized two-component complex vector
acceptance: the four alphabet states are unique and encode every sign pair of I and Q
each adjacent Gray-cycle state, including closure, changes exactly one bit
inversion is involutive and produces exactly 180 degrees of phase separation
mirror-inversion yields the frozen right word
quadrature magnitude equals requested amplitude and bias magnitude
one electron crossing 211 mV changes energy by exactly 0.211 eV
211 mV is below the 1.12 eV silicon indirect bandgap reference
the low-bias cubic transfer is odd under voltage inversion
WKB transmission decreases monotonically with barrier width and barrier height
the remembered word is reported as two quadrants, not silently promoted to four
invalid states and invalid WKB domains fail closed
the four transport phases advance in the frozen order and close to LOCATE
the reference spinor is normalized, flips sign at 2*pi, and returns at 4*pi
one million deterministic evaluations remain finite and complete

established: silicon indirect bandgap reference near 1.12 eV
proposed: 211 mV as this design's frozen operating bias
not_claimed: 211 mV as a universal tunnelling voltage

freeze_seal.scope: canonical JSON serialization of the normative object

change_rule: Any change to normative semantics, constants, alphabet, equations, word, acceptance gates, or seal requires a new contract version.
